responsibility: Provides the shared middle-layer compiler metadata and query-backed analyses that sit between HIR/type checking and later code generation or diagnostics: it groups canonical representations for codegen-relevant function attributes, dependency linkage formats, exported symbols, effective visibility, lexical region scope trees, and resolved lifetime bindings; exposes `TyCtxt` accessors for language items and stability/deprecation evaluation; computes crate-level compiler limits; and, through `mod.rs`, defines shared library-feature tracking structures and registers this module’s query providers so these facilities work together as common compiler state for reachability, lifetime/region reasoning, API gating, and linking decisions.
